sn6.9:1.2: His illness was caused by slandering Sāriputta and Moggallāna ([sn6.10](), [an10.89](), [snp3.10:3.3]()). | [an10.89]() combines this Sutta and the next.
sn6.9:3.3: The ancient Indian game of dice involved casting _vibhītaka_ seeds (also known as “bedda nuts”, from Terminalia bellirica) in a hollow, from which the players would take a handful. A number divisible by four was “perfect” (_kaṭa_), so the fifth seed meant a “losing” hand (_kali_; cf. _apaṇṇaka_ in [mn60]() and notes).
sn6.9:5.1: The interpretation and calculation of these lines is explained at [snp3.10:12.2]().
